name: Murder at the Manor
description: A guest lies dead at the manor. Each suspect was in a different room with a different motive. Work out whodunit.
clues: Either Writing goes with Crane or Butler goes with Lounge.

Exactly one of these is true: Crane goes with Heir; Holloway goes with Lounge; Library goes with Butler.

Crane, Cellar, Heir, and Walking belong to different suspects.
Gardener goes with exactly two of Holloway, Lounge, and Painting.
Holloway goes with neither Butler nor Walking.
